name: com.driftsys.dashscene
description: The C# side of dashscene. The boundary-B value types, the host that sits on the C ABI — version negotiation, runtime lifetime, document load, the tick and the committed frame — and the BatchRendererGroup painter that draws those tables. No native library yet, and the painter draws fills, strokes, corners and clips but no shadows, blurs, images or text. See docs/roadmap.md for the slices that add them.

samples.description: A MonoBehaviour that loads a .dsb, ticks it, and takes each committed frame. It does not yet hand those tables to BrgPainter, which this package now ships — wiring the two together is a follow-up.
